name: Edwin Bulpin
role: Medora telegraph operator and railroad agent
bio: Edwin Bulpin was Medora's telegraph operator and in February 1884 was also made express, freight and ticket agent, and the paper ran a comic poem about his hunting. In March 1884 he resigned to take a telegraph job on the Utah Northern in Idaho, and Hugh Flynn replaced him.

moments.label: Appointed express, freight and ticket agent
Left for a telegraph job in Idaho

mentions: Edwin Bulpin, who is now telegraph operator at Medora, has been appointed express, freight and ticket agent. His many friends will be pleased to learn of his advancement.
